key_findings: Activation functions (GELU, SiLU) are suboptimal compared to ReLU² (1.013+ vs 0.9954)
Learning rates are the primary optimization lever; a2/a3's tuned values (0.8/0.006/0.06) critical
Scalar_lr has sharp optimum at 0.35: adjacent values 0.34 (0.996397) and 0.36 (0.995675) both significantly worse
Architecture (8 layers, aspect ratio 64) is optimal; depth/width changes by all agents consistently harm performance
Convergence plateau at ~0.9954 appears fundamental for this 5-minute budget
Weight decay tuning (0.15 optimal) and attention patterns secondary to learning rate optimization
